title: Get Map Working End to End
description: Get GIS/map (dev:gis:2d) working end to end. Build currently fails with missing `presence` field on UiInspectorFieldGroup in gis/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Fix compile errors and any further blockers so the map app runs.
summary: Fixed GIS 2D Render error (TiledMapHost mapped undefined contextMenu.specs) and restored app actions via DocumentApp::command_from_action bridge (GIS maps host {action,args} onto Gis2dCommand). Rebuilt gis wasm. Verified: no render error, Map canvas, Reuse Map, OSM/VT tiles, setActiveExample tests ok.
